brief: a pricing page for a solo developer tool

intent.purpose: a place to compare plans and understand what it costs to use this tool as an individual developer
intent.audience: solo developers evaluating whether this tool is worth paying for

gaps.where: click subscribe on one of the paid plans
gaps.detail: viewer read 'click subscribe on one of the paid plans' as the main action, intended 'choose a plan'
viewer read it as "a pricing comparison page for a developer api or backend service called 'relay', letting users choose between four subscription tiers."

gaps.where: The difference between 'Free' and 'Get started' vs 'Subscribe' labeling is slightly inconsistent and requires a beat to parse
The toggle says '20% off' for Annual but there is no visible annual pricing shown — unclear whether the prices displayed are already annual or still monthly
The label 'PLANS' above the table feels redundant and adds no information
The subtitle taglines under each plan name (Evaluate, One developer, Power users, Up to 5 seats) are small and low contrast but technically readable at normal screen size
gaps.detail: too small or too low contrast to read comfortably

gaps.where: The 'billed monthly' micro-copy under each price is small enough to miss
gaps.detail: too small or too low contrast to read comfortably
